notes: KNOWN FAILING (documented target, not yet live-recorded -- route is driver-gap: no driver in the repo has a seed_instruction/file/write primitive yet). Muse loads a persistent AGENTS.md project-rules file at session start, verbatim, wrapped in a <rules-file scope="" written-for="Muse Code..."> tag inside a <system-reminder source="rules-file"> block (confirmed via `strings` on the installed muse-bin-1.2.1-R2847.1 binary, and independently corroborated by the live corpus's context_block_diagnostic{block_id:"rules_file",source:"rules_file",lifecycle:"session_start"} bookkeeping, muse-format-spec.md section 11), so a marker rule seeded into that file should reach the model the same way a CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md rule reaches claudecode/codex. Once emitted, session metrics should carry task_estimate {total_rounds:4, completed_rounds:M} matching the marker (completed_rounds<=total_rounds), updated_at advancing on each fresher marker, completed_rounds non-decreasing and reaching 4 on the final working turn, task_completion_eta present once completed_rounds>=1 and burning down (later eta <= earlier), and both fields absent at ready (suppressed-by-state). These metric assertions are NOT expressible in the phase DSL (cf. muse/basic-turn spec); they belong in the recipe verify[] once recorded. TODAY the muse adapter's parseAssistantMessageCommitted (core/adapters/inbound/agents/muse/parser.go:448-459) extracts the full un-truncated assistant text into the local `text` variable and immediately truncates it via tailer.TruncateAssistantText WITHOUT ever calling tailer.ScanTaskEstimate first -- violating that function's own documented contract (core/pkg/tailer/parser.go:1126-1127: "Adapters MUST scan the full text for markers (ScanTaskEstimate) BEFORE calling this -- the dropped head can carry a task-estimate marker"). grep confirms zero references to TaskEstimate/ScanTaskEstimate anywhere in core/adapters/inbound/agents/muse/. So ev.TaskEstimate is never set and task_estimate/task_completion_eta can never surface for muse today, regardless of what the model emits -- the identical shape commit 1ae457d9 fixed for codex/pi/aider/opencode (core/pkg/tailer/taskestimate_scan.go is the shared, adapter-agnostic scan; wiring it into muse's existing text-extraction call site is a small, precedented daemon fix, not an architectural block). The phases below assert only the user-observable STATE arc the marker would ride on (ready->working->ready), single-birth per muse's session model (no ProcessMatcher/presession split -- muse-format-spec.md section 1, and replaydata/agents/muse/scenarios/2-1_basic-turn/expected.jsonl's committed precedent).
